one_line_description.value: Firecrawl is a context API for AI agents that searches, scrapes, and interacts with the live web to return clean Markdown or structured data.
one_line_description.quote: Firecrawl is the context API for AI agents.

has_public_api.quote: The Firecrawl API gives you programmatic access to web data.

api_type.quote: Your own code calling the REST API for your team

api_breadth.value: REST, ~9 capability areas (Search, Scrape, Interact, Parse, Monitor, Crawl, Map, Agent, Alexandria), read-write
api_breadth.quote: The Firecrawl API gives you programmatic access to web data. All endpoints share a common base URL, authentication scheme, and response format described on this page.

auth_methods.quote: Choose between API keys, hosted MCP and OAuth for calling Firecrawl

oauth_scopes_documented.quote: | `firecrawl:global` | Full access to the Firecrawl REST API on the chosen team, using that team's credits.

access_model.quote: Sign up for a free API key to get 1,000 credits and higher rate limits at no cost

access_notes.value: Self-serve free account: sign up for a free API key with 1,000 monthly credits, and keyless access is available for /v2/scrape, /v2/search and /v2/parse. Every other endpoint (crawl, map, extract, agent, batch scrape, job status) requires a key. Higher rate/concurrency limits require paid Hobby/Standard/Growth/Scale plans, and custom enterprise limits require contacting Firecrawl.
access_notes.quote: Every other endpoint, including crawl, map, extract, agent, batch scrape and job status, needs a key.

official_mcp_server.quote: The keyless server URL (Search, Scrape, and Parse; no credential required) is `https://mcp.firecrawl.dev/v2/mcp`.

rate_limits.value: Per-plan requests/minute and concurrency: Free 10 scrape/map/search, 2 crawl, 2 concurrent browsers; Hobby 100/20/5; Standard 500/100/25; Growth 5,000/1,000/50; Scale 10,000/2,000/100+. Exceeding limits returns HTTP 429.

webhooks.quote: Firecrawl sends webhook events at each stage of a job's lifecycle, so you can track progress, capture results, and handle failures in real time without polling.

sdk_languages.quote: See the Python SDK, Node SDK, or API reference to build it into your application.

api_versioning_or_deprecation_notes.value: Versioning is path-based with v1 and v2 base paths; the current API reference is v2. No explicit deprecation/sunset policy was present in the supplied evidence.

verdict_reason: Firecrawl has public, well-documented REST docs (v2 reference), self-serve free credentials (1,000 free credits/month plus keyless endpoints), and multiple auth paths including API keys and OAuth 2.1. The API surface is broad (search, scrape, crawl, map, extract, interact, agent) with documented per-plan rate limits and an official vendor MCP server. Higher concurrency is gated to paid/enterprise plans, but development access is free and self-serve.
open_questions: No independent community MCP servers were found in the bundle; the only MCP listing (github.com/mcp/firecrawl/firecrawl-mcp-server) appears to be the vendor's own registry entry, and github.com/mcp/firecrawl returned 404. Confirm whether any credible third-party MCP servers exist.

No dedicated API sandbox/test environment was documented in the supplied pages; only a browser Playground and the Interact 'browser sandbox' product appear. Confirm whether a separate test mode/environment exists.
No API deprecation or sunset policy text was included; confirm the official versioning/deprecation policy beyond the existence of /v1 and /v2 paths.
Official SDK coverage in the evidence names Python and Node only; confirm whether additional official SDKs (e.g., Go, Java) exist.
Enterprise custom limits require contacting Firecrawl (help@firecrawl.com); confirm the exact thresholds that trigger enterprise-only access.
